description: This file defines the SurveysViewReports class, a view component for rendering survey report details within a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for fetching survey statistics, processing responses, and generating data for visualizations in reports.

classes.name: SurveysViewReports
classes.description: A view class for generating survey reports, extending SugarView, with methods to get survey stats and prepare data for reporting visualizations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new instance and calls parent constructor.

methods.name: getSurveyStats
methods.description: Retrieves counts of sent surveys and distinct recipients from the database for current survey.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to generate the report view, process survey responses, prepare chart data, and render the report template.

methods.name: getCheckboxQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Prepares skeleton data structure for checkbox type questions.

methods.name: getMatrixQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Prepares skeleton data for matrix questions with options.

methods.name: getChoiceQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Prepares skeleton data for multiple choice questions.

methods.name: getRatingQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Prepares skeleton data for rating questions.

methods.name: getScaleQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Prepares skeleton data for scale questions.

methods.name: generateSkeletonData
methods.description: Generates initial data structure for survey questions to be filled with response data.
